review_type: Official BOP math/source documentation only; no actual dataset body or code execution.

projection.equation: p_c=R_m2c p_m+t_m2c; homogeneous p_i=K p_c; u=p_i[0]/p_i[2], v=p_i[1]/p_i[2].
projection.units: BOP mesh coordinates and translation vectors are mm. Scene uint16 depth multiplied by per-frame depth_scale gives camera-axis Z in mm; K remains pixel units. Do not mix meter-space original models with converted poses or infer scale by fitting.
projection.coordinate_system: Right-handed OpenCV camera: +Z forward; image x right/y down. Preserve supplied camera and pose, no axis reorder or K/q adjustment.
projection.pixel_centers: BOP misc depth conversion uses zero-based integer array coordinates (x=column,y=row) with no +0.5; project_pts is continuous K projection with no implicit shift. A CPU integer-center ray convention is explicit and consistent with this depth convention.
projection.renderer_limit: Official Vispy uses a K-to-OpenGL projection with x0=y0=0, flips camera Y/Z and image rows. Raster sample/fill/edge and precision conventions remain renderer-specific; CPU integer-ray results are not promised byte-identical to supplied masks. Do not choose offsets from observed overlap.

depth.sensor_Z: For valid pixel(u,v), X=(u-cx)*Z/fx, Y=(v-cy)*Z/fy for standard pinholeK.
depth.signed_probe_residual: Compare Z_model - raw_depth*depth_scale only where both are positive finite. Preserve signed distribution, support counts and missing partitions; no residual threshold labels.
depth.BOP_visibility_distinction: Official calc_gt_masks converts BOTH scene and rendered Z to Euclidean range before BOP visibility(delta in mm). A range-tolerance test is not the same as a fixed Z-tolerance test off axis. No such threshold classification is required by this probe.
depth.zero_missing: Raw sensor0 is missing/UNKNOWN and excluded from residual statistics, never unoccluded/occluded truth. Rendered no-hit is separate absent model support. BOP19 missingdepth-visible convention must not supply new supervision here.

CPU_firstsurface_contract: Render each fixed GT-list obj1 instance alone, all5; no best instance or pose choice. Geometry/pose are unmodified and GT is diagnostic only.
Use perspective-correct triangle Z: Z=1/(lambda0/Z0+lambda1/Z1+lambda2/Z2), or an equivalent camera-ray triangle intersection. Screen-linear interpolation of vertexZ is wrong for slanted triangles.

Both triangle faces participate (official Vispy cull_face=False). Resolve nearest positive finiteZ; exact ties keep original first triangle index. Preserve source triangle IDs/winding; do not repair/merge geometry to improve masks.

Declare fixed near-plane clipping and raster edge/tie conventions before bodies; test oblique depth, overlap, winding, clipping and no-hit with invented geometry. C reports fixed1e-6mm nearplane and integer-center convention, no outcome adaptation.

mask_comparison_claims.full_mask: Target-alone model depth>0 yields a projected whole-object first-surface silhouette. Its overlap/XOR/boundary differences with supplied per-instance full mask are registration/raster consistency evidence only.
mask_comparison_claims.visible_mask: Provided visible mask may be compared with target-alone support and sensor-depth validity/residual partitions. Difference from full mask alone is not a selected-part self/external classification.
